scope: Read-only source/manual review for decoder-only fixed 200MHz, private contiguous WC DMA buffer and targeted IOMMU bypass route; full IOMMU translation stays disabled. No board access, register writes, builds or public Git mutation by reviewer.

bypass.bit0: 1 bypass, 0 translation; preserve all other bits using RMW and verify readback
bypass.preserve: No IOMMU global ENABLE, RESET, TTB, TLB or other MIC writes; do not copy software DEFAULT_BYPASS_VALUE=0x3ff to a hardware global register.
bypass.ccu_reset_boundary: Root explicitly permits CCU IOMMU1_SYS at 0x020025b4 bit16 0->1 only to deassert initial reset, never assert or pulse. Existing bit16=1 is unchanged; bits2:0 may be enabled. This is distinct from an IOMMU core RESET register write.
bypass.lifetime: DEC PPU must be powered while accessing these MICs; keep necessary shared IOMMU1 clock references pinned, do not turn off shared gates on consumer close.

power.control: PPU+0 low nibble requested 8; PPU+8 low nibble must reach 8 within bounded timeout; preserve other control bits.
power.donor_bug: sunxi_do_pmu_set_power_domain logs timeout and returns void, while sunxi_pd_power always returns 0. New provider must propagate timeout; reviewed provider does.
power.rail: T736 demo_aiot board.dts:2905-2912 assigns VE and VE2 to AXP8191 DCDC2. All eleven VE VF entries in sun60iw2p1-cpu-vf.dtsi:2142-2190 are 624MHz at 800000uV.
power.voltage_conclusion: No source evidence requires raising an already verified 900mV system/DCDC2 rail for fixed 200MHz. This review did not read the live PMIC; actual supply must be established through the existing bus owner, not inferred from DTS alone.
power.DCDC2_decode: AXP8191 DCDC2 enable is DCDC_CTL1 bit1, voltage selector bits6:0; ranges 500000+selector*10000uV for 0..0x46 and 1220000+(selector-0x47)*20000uV for 0x47..0x57. Preserve DVM/phase/feedback and shared consumers.

clock.core: 0x02002a88: bit31 gate, mux bits26:24=2 for PERI0_800M, divider bits4:0=3 gives /4; bits30:27 reserved, no UPD handshake.
clock.parent: Use existing locked PLL_REF=24MHz and PLL_PERI0_800M=800MHz. PERI0 output1 gate bit26, P1 bits18:16 plus1, N bits15:8 plus1, input M1 bit1 plus1. No PLL_VE0 programming or enabling is required by this selected source.
clock.ready_recommendation: Implemented and independently rechecked: PLL_REF and PERI0 require EN, LDO_EN, LOCK and selected output gate. No PLL writes.

gates.0x020025e0: DEC master bit14 and IOMMU1 master bit1
gates.0x02002a8c: DEC bus bit2, DEC reset bit18; preserve encoder reset16/bus0

shared_gate_finding.problem: Donor SUNXI_CCU_GATE_WITH_KEY constants overlap real manual-documented R/W gate bits; blindly ORing them changes other masters, despite the helper comment that key-field bits read zero.

examples.0x010000ff: AHB bit24 STORE and bits0..7 many masters
examples.0x41055800: MBUS STORE30, VI24, NPU18, GPU16, DEC14, ENC12, DE11
examples.0x00040302: MBUS gate DEC18, ISP9, CSI8, ENC1

shared_gate_finding.manual: reference-1.txt lines6499-6748: R/W gates, no dedicated key field documented.
shared_gate_finding.recommendation: New decoder provider should update only its target bits with RMW and readback. Do not wholesale change historical display/USB drivers in this review.
shared_gate_finding.verified_correction: clk-t736-ve.c removed key field and all key ORs. enable RMWs only selected masks; disable preserves others. Shared IOMMU1 gates remain pinned.

nsi.masks: mode bits1:0=0; priority bits3:0=0x5 (read/write pri1); select bit0=1. T736 uses direct port numbering, not SUN55IW3 legacy port-1 mapping.
nsi.interpretation: Donor configuration controls QoS/priority input selection, not a per-port traffic enable. No reviewed evidence makes reconfiguring these QoS values a prerequisite for a bounded decoder trial. Preserve current global NSI/MBUS clock/reset state and other ports; do not import donor all-master initialization.

reset_and_dma.donor_vcu_pulse: After module enable and IOCTL_RESET_VE, donor RMWs decoder base+0x804 (0x01c0e804) bits0 and4 to1 then0, preserving other bits; cedar_ve.c:388-405,532-537,966-971.
reset_and_dma.completion_boundary: No reviewed kernel donor/manual evidence proves outstanding external DMA is drained merely because DEC reset is asserted or its bit reads back. A fixed delay is not completion proof.
reset_and_dma.root_design_response: Root requested imported buffers permanently pinned through reboot with a bounded budget; permanent pinning applies even to closes/releases until a supported quiescence boundary exists.
reset_and_dma.userspace_review: desktop_review identified veInquireIdle but has not established that it means external DMA drain; do not treat its name or loop as proof.
reset_and_dma.reset_API: Linux reset_control_reset returns -ENOTSUPP when provider has no .reset, without assert/deassert fallback. Cedar must explicitly assert/deassert and check results; root reports new consumer does so.
reset_and_dma.consumer_status: code_index reports frozen driver SHA256 5c9a73ed2d701bfb5905aa59da73f7f07f60b1c0636c6746f1b7110a68265402: explicit assert/status/deassert; permanently pins imported buffers until reboot, total budget128MiB. Independent hardware reviewer did not rerun its build/tests.

mmio_boundary.donor: Decoder DTS resource 0x3000 also covers encoder page.
mmio_boundary.finding: For decoder-only interface, restrict mmap to first 0x2000 or shrink resource after checking userspace ABI. Root and code_index notified.
mmio_boundary.verified_correction: Root changed t736-media-v27.dtsi decoder resource to0x2000; code_index reports the consumer permits only offset0 length0x1000 MMIO mapping.

remaining_boundaries: Actual PMIC/DCDC2 voltage and device state require root-owned live evidence. No voltage, PLL or NSI tuning was performed by reviewer.
No DMA drain completion was proved; keep permanent imported-buffer pinning and bounded allocation policy.
Fixed200MHz, target-onlybypass and source verification do not establish actual decode, encode, browser integration, performance or final image acceptance.
